sources.title: Bhutan Broadcasting Service Corporation: Expression of Interest for conduct of the Reality Shows during the weekday (2026-2027)
sources.said: BBS shall select and award contracts to four (4) successful organizers. Under this EoI, each organizer shall be provided the opportunity to conduct two (2) seasons of a weekday show for the 2026–2027 period. … There will be 10 episodes minimum and 18 episodes maximum. … Show organisers will be given eight minutes of advertisement airtime every hour. 2. They may also seek sponsors for their shows. … 4. BBS will charge Nu. 70,000 (seventy thousand Ngultrums) per episode if the show is hosted at a BBS studio and Nu. 50,000 (fifty thousand Ngultrums) if it is hosted at other studios.

sources.title: BBS: Expression of Interest, Terms of Reference for Reality Shows for 2022 and beyond (Updated, September 2024)
sources.said: In addition to the six reality shows, there were six new applicants waiting for the opportunity to host their own shows on BBS. They had applied for and been granted permits by BICMA to host shows on the BBS. … The reality show organisers keep 80% of the revenue from the SMS votes. … As a fee, BBS charges Nu. 70,000 (seventy thousand Ngultrums) per episode if the show is hosted at a BBS studio and Nu. 50,000 (fifty thousand Ngultrums) if it is hosted at other studios.

figures.finding: Not searched this run. The only route for an independent production onto BBS published today runs the other way from a commission: the producer pays BBS per episode and sells airtime. No scripted-series call, tariff or pickup count was found (a 2016 BCMD tender for a 15-part BBS series surfaced in a search, closed and old, not read).
